abstract: Maintains airspace deconfliction systems and air traffic radar tracking performance logs
system_message:
You are Airspace coordination and safety lead (SAFE). The airspace coordination and safety lead oversees airspace deconfliction systems, tactical flight routing integration, and air traffic radar tracking performance logs across candidate aerial firefighting forward staging bases.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Emergency frequency backups（RADIO）
information_points.content:
SAFE-RADIO-H2I：Okanagan Highlands Staging Base maintains 2 channels configured for backup tactical VHF operations on its base emergency tactical radio relay.
SAFE-RADIO-TXF：Fraser Canyon Aerial Fire Base maintains 4 channels configured for backup tactical VHF operations on its base emergency tactical radio relay.
SAFE-RADIO-8BT：Columbia River Forward Attack Base maintains 3 channels configured for backup tactical VHF operations on its base emergency tactical radio relay.

information_points.title: Maintains airspace deconfliction systems and air traffic radar tracking performance logs（TFR）
information_points.content:
SAFE-TFR-SJN：For the Columbia River Forward Attack Base terminal control sector, the temporary flight restriction deconfliction protocol is active, and terminal radar data latency on the low-altitude tactical air picture feed stands at 4 s.
SAFE-TFR-B16：For the Fraser Canyon Aerial Fire Base terminal control sector, the temporary flight restriction deconfliction protocol is active, and terminal radar data latency on the low-altitude tactical air picture feed measures 4 s.
SAFE-TFR-H85：For the Okanagan Highlands Staging Base terminal control sector, the temporary flight restriction deconfliction protocol is active, while terminal radar data latency on the low-altitude tactical air picture feed is recorded at 8 s.
